title: הכדור שמסגיר את עצמו 500 פעמים בשנייה
summary: The connected World Cup ball: the 500 Hz IMU inside Al Rihla showed no 'heartbeat' at Ronaldo's head (Portugal 2–0 Uruguay, 28 Nov 2022) so the goal went to Bruno Fernandes; an accelerometer feels only external force (touch = spike, free flight = quiet line); semi-automated offside — the sensor gives the moment of the pass, 12 roof cameras track 29 points per player 50×/s, the line goes through the most forward scoring body part (arms excluded, Law 11); 18 cm between camera frames vs 1.8 cm between sensor reports; linesmen's 26% errors in 2002 and flash-lag (Helsen 2006); Track160 (Tel Aviv); speed from slow-mo frames, ×3.6 to km/h, and a relative-speed challenge.
reviewer_verdict: PASS (3 rounds) — nits left: reviewer estimates ~35–40 min (younger) / ~35 min (older) vs the 'כ־25 דקות' tag; the Arto button covers each canvas's bottom-left corner on phones (engine); kit lint/check missing from the repo so local stand-ins were used; Arto and the AI grader not exercised offline; review copy doesn't declare the sample capability (template)
